up: Retrieve all bioactivity rows for compound CHEMBL122 (ROFECOXIB) and all its salts with IC50 values in nM against target CHEMBL230 (Prostaglandin G/H synthase 2). Include the parent compound and all related salts using molecule_hierarchy parent mapping from CHEMBL122. Return columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
sql:
WITH compound_set AS (
  SELECT child.molregno, child.chembl_id
  FROM molecule_dictionary parent
  JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno
  JOIN molecule_dictionary child ON child.molregno = mh.molregno
  WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL122'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  a.assay_description,
  act.standard_type,
  act.standard_relation,
  act.standard_value,
  act.standard_units,
  act.activity_comment,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM compound_set md
JOIN activities act ON md.molregno = act.molregno
JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid
LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id
LEFT JOIN docs d ON act.doc_id = d.doc_id
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL230'
  AND act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.standard_units = 'nM';

up: Retrieve activity details for compound CHEMBL122 (ROFECOXIB) and all its salts which have an IC50 bioactivity value in nM against target CHEMBL230 (Prostaglandin G/H synthase 2). Use molecule_hierarchy parent mapping from CHEMBL122 to include the parent compound and all related salts. Return exactly compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not limit the number of rows.
sql:
WITH compound_set AS (
  SELECT parent.molregno, parent.chembl_id
  FROM molecule_dictionary parent
  WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL122'
  UNION
  SELECT child.molregno, child.chembl_id
  FROM molecule_dictionary parent
  JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno
  JOIN molecule_dictionary child ON child.molregno = mh.molregno
  WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL122'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  assays.description AS assay_description,
  act.standard_type,
  act.standard_relation,
  act.standard_value,
  act.standard_units,
  act.activity_comment,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM compound_set md
JOIN activities act ON md.molregno = act.molregno
JOIN assays ON act.assay_id = assays.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON assays.tid = td.tid
LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id
LEFT JOIN docs d ON act.doc_id = d.doc_id
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL230'
  AND act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.standard_units = 'nM';
